summary: Run Map.forEach with a statically known callback through existing JsFunction call semantics.

target.notes: JsMap.ForEach must invoke the callback via canonical JsFunction call lowering as callback(value,key,map) with thisArg.

semantics.mutation_during_iteration: deleted-before-visit skipped; added-before-completion visited; delete+readd may revisit

caveats: Do not use LINQ foreach over a snapshot; mutation visibility differs.

tests.name: addition during callback visited
tests.input: const m=new Map([['a',1]]); const seen=[]; m.forEach((v,k)=>{seen.push(k); if(k==='a')m.set('b',2)}); console.log(seen);
